name: Passive Network Reconnaissance
description: The Shark Jack is a compact network implant designed for fast, passive network reconnaissance. Plugged into any network port, it automatically scans the local segment, identifies hosts, and captures network data. It is designed for short-duration deployment and rapid extraction — plug in, wait, pull out. Preferred for reliability in fixed-port deployments where power is available.

blue.det: Unknown MAC address on DHCP logs; NAC alert on unauthorized device; brief network scan activity visible in logs.
blue.cm: NAC requiring authentication before network access; 802.1X port authentication; DHCP monitoring for unknown MACs; physical port locks on unused ports.
